Forced narrative subtitle

Definition

Forced narrative subtitle is a subtitle shown only when essential foreign dialogue or on-screen text requires translation. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align localization decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.
